title: Object-Contextual Representations for Semantic Segmentation (OCR)
mechanism: Soft class-region representations are aggregated and returned to each pixel weighted by pixel-region relation.
adaptation: Inactive almost always touches a crack: an OCR head on the stride-4 decoder gives each pixel the cell's crack-region and inactive-region descriptors before the final upsample.
min_experiment: Arm: house PF + OCR head; baseline: house PF; CV inactive IoU (primary), BMRK inactive IoU. Kill if CV inactive IoU < +0.02.
evidence: R: HRNet + OCR + SegFix was 1st on Cityscapes at ECCV 2020 deadline.
